[P] Session persistence and reopening
|
DiagramChangeSessionRepository
`-- DiagramChangeSessionStore
    |-- listSummaries / readSummary
    |   `-- ChangeSessionRecords metadata paths
    |-- read / readPreview / write
    |   `-- optional backend worker -> ChangeSessionRecords
    `-- persisted session
        |-- <session>.manifest.json
        |   |-- summary
        |   |-- document references
        |   `-- receipt references
        |-- content-addressed document and receipt payloads
        `-- DiagramPersistence
            |-- persist: diagrams/history -> immutable record references
            |-- restore: references -> portable diagram/history data
            `-- DiagramRecordStore -> DiagramRevisionStore
                |-- put(): SHA-256 address + atomic write
                `-- get(): read + verify content hash

Selected previews omit editing-history payloads.
Writes publish changed document/receipt references through the manifest.
Catalog acceptance is a separate atomic publication.
ChangeSessionService.get() repairs accepted state from its catalog receipt.
